news_items.headline: Union Pacific rallies to 52-week high after Q1 earnings beat
news_items.summary: UNP stock hit a 52-week high following Q1 results: net income $1.7B (+5% YoY), EPS $2.87 (+6% YoY). Management reiterated 2026 mid-single-digit EPS growth guidance and a 3-year EPS CAGR target of high single-digit to low double-digit through 2027.

news_items.headline: UNP declares $1.38 cash dividend with ex-date May 29, 2026
news_items.summary: Union Pacific announced a quarterly cash dividend of $1.38 per share; ex-dividend date is May 29, 2026.

news_items.headline: State attorneys general question completeness of UNP-NSC merger application
news_items.summary: State AGs raised concerns about the completeness of Union Pacific's revised merger application with Norfolk Southern ($85B deal); the Surface Transportation Board is expected to enter a year-long review. UNP says the revised application addresses regulatory concerns and aims to enhance competition.

news_items.headline: Benchmark raises UNP price target to $300 from $275; maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Benchmark lifted its price target on Union Pacific to $300 (from $275) while keeping a Buy rating, citing improved earnings visibility and operational execution.

news_items.headline: Raymond James raises UNP price target to $310; Strong Buy
news_items.summary: Raymond James raised its price target on UNP to $310 from $285 and maintained a Strong Buy rating.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Multiple PT raises this week: Raymond James to $310 (Strong Buy), Benchmark to $300 (Buy), TD Cowen to $282 (Buy), Evercore ISI to $277 (Outperform), BMO Capital to $285 (Market Perform), UBS to $274 (Neutral). Consensus Buy across 23 analysts (~67% Buy) with avg PT $291.05 (+8.1% upside).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported — net income $1.7B (+5% YoY), EPS $2.87 (+6%), record Q1 strength; stock hit 52-week high post-report. Street expects continued operating-ratio improvement and mid-single-digit EPS growth in 2026; merger-related costs and intermodal softness are flagged as near-term headwinds.
